headlines.title: Goldman Sachs Sees U.S. Natural Gas Demand Surging on Data Center Boom
headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs expects rapid U.S. data center expansion through 2028 to boost electricity and natural gas demand.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs closing on $1.5B private credit secondaries deal
headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs is closing on a secondaries deal involving private credit assets from one of its non-traded BDCs with a fair value of about $1.5 billion as of March 31, according to market sources. Coller EQT is leading the GP-led deal, sources said. The deal will involve about $600 million of equity, with the lead investor providing $200-300 million and the rest being allocated to other credit secondaries investors. Pricing on the deal is 94.75, sources said.

headlines.title: Wealthfront to Present at the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference
headlines.summary: PALO ALTO, Calif., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Wealthfront Corporation (Nasdaq: WLTH) today announced that it will be presenting at the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference on Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 3:40 pm ET. A live audio webcast will be available at Wealthfront’s Investor Relations website that day at https://ir.wealthfront.com/news-events/events.

headlines.title: Goldman, Morgan Stanley and Evercore Are Advising on What Could Be the Biggest Deal Ever
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are advising SpaceX’s special committee, and Evercore is advising Tesla’s, on a possible all-stock merger of two companies worth about $3. 3 trillion together, the Financial Times reported.

headlines.title: BlackRock’s Martin S. Small to Present at the 2026 Goldman Sachs US Financial Services Conference on December 8th
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, November 24, 2026--BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) today announced that Martin S. Small, Chief Financial Officer, is scheduled to speak at the 2026 Goldman Sachs US Financial Services Conference on December 8th, 2026, beginning at approximately 2:20 p.m. ET. A live webcast will be accessible via the "Investor Relations" section of BlackRock’s website, www.blackrock.com.

description: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., a financial institution, provides a range of financial services for corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. It operates through three segments: Global Banking & Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, and Platform Solutions. The Global Banking & Markets segment provides financial advisory services, including strategic advisory assignments related to mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, corporate defense activities, restructurings, and spin-offs; equity and debt underwriting of public offerings and private placements; relationship lending and acquisition financing; secured lending through structured credit and asset-backed lending, such as warehouse, residential and commercial mortgage, corporate, consumer, auto, and student loans; financing through securities purchased under agreements to resell; and commodity financing through structured transactions. This segment also offers client execution activities for cash and derivative instruments; credit and interest rate products; and provision of mortgages, currencies, commodities, and equities related products. Its Asset & Wealth Management segment manages assets across various classes, including equity, fixed income, hedge funds, credit funds, private equity, real estate, currencies, commodities, and asset allocation strategies; and provides customized investment advisory solutions, wealth advisory services, personalized financial planning, and private banking services, as well as invests in corporate equity, credit, real estate, and infrastructure assets. The Platform Solutions segment offers credit cards; and transaction banking and other services, such as deposit-taking, payment solutions, and other cash management services for corporate and institutional clients. The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
